description:
On the /fly route, the HUD heliocentric speed readout displays 'NaN km/s' for the entire transit of outer-planet missions (destinations beyond Mars: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres)

Expected: The HUD speed readout must show the spacecraft's real heliocentric orbital speed (a finite positive number in km/s) at every frame along the transfer trajectory, for all destinations including outer planets

Acceptance criteria:
- For every outer-planet mission (dest=JUPITER|SATURN|URANUS|NEPTUNE|PLUTO|CERES), the speed displayed on the /fly HUD must be a positive finite number at every frame position along the transfer arc — not NaN, not zero, not negative [code-invariant: NaN, zero, and negative values are unrecoverable display errors; the app must never show any of them in a user-facing numeric speed readout. A positive definite speed magnitude is self-evident for an orbiting body.]
- At departure (r ≈ R_EARTH_AU ≈ 1.0 AU), the HUD speed must match the vis-viva value for a Hohmann transfer from Earth to that destination: v = sqrt(MU_SUN_AU3_YR2 × (2/1.0 - 1/a_transfer)) × AU_PER_YR_TO_KMS, where a_transfer = (R_EARTH_AU + dest.a) / 2, and dest.a is the destination's semi-major axis from DESTINATIONS (lambert-grid.constants.ts:131-144, already imported at +page.svelte:65) [spec: ADR-010: 'Transfer arc: Keplerian half-ellipses' (Hohmann transfer definition); AGENTS.md physics section quotes vis-viva formula; fly-physics.ts:39-40 defines heliocentricSpeed = sqrt(MU_SUN × (2/r - 1/a)) × AU_YR_TO_KMS; DESTINATIONS at lambert-grid.constants.ts:131-144 supplies per-destination a values (jupiter.a=5.203, saturn.a=9.537, etc.)]
- At arrival (r ≈ dest.a, the destination's semi-major axis), the HUD speed must be finite and positive, computed from the same destination-specific a_transfer: v = sqrt(MU_SUN_AU3_YR2 × (2/dest.a - 1/a_transfer)) × AU_PER_YR_TO_KMS [spec: Same sources as criterion 2: Hohmann transfer per ADR-010 + vis-viva formula + DESTINATIONS a values. For a correct a_transfer, the radicand (2/dest.a - 2/(R_EARTH_AU + dest.a)) = 2 × R_EARTH_AU / (dest.a × (R_EARTH_AU + dest.a)) > 0 for any dest.a > 0, so the value is always finite and positive.]

Domain facts:
- Vis-viva equation v = sqrt(μ × (2/r - 1/a)) is valid only for r in [a×(1−e), a×(1+e)] (the transfer ellipse bounds). With correct a_transfer = (R_EARTH_AU + dest.a)/2 for Hohmann, the radicand is always positive for r in [R_EARTH_AU, dest.a] — no NaN possible.
- DESTINATIONS table (lambert-grid.constants.ts:131-144) supplies per-destination semi-major axis `a` for all 13+ destinations and is already imported at +page.svelte:65.
- fly/physics.ts:39-40 (heliocentricSpeed) is a correct pure vis-viva function — its radicand clamp is a workaround, not a fix.
